source: openFDA drug/drugsfda.json (approvals, keyless 240/min + 1,000/day) + Federal Register API v1 (FDA advisory-committee meeting notices, keyless)
license: openFDA: US public data (open.fda.gov/license). Federal Register: US Government public domain. Both product-surfaceable with attribution. NOTE: PDUFA target dates are NOT included — FDA is legally barred from confirming pending applications (21 CFR 314.430); commercial aggregator calendars are ToS-protected and are NOT scraped.
attribution: openFDA (U.S. Food & Drug Administration); Federal Register (U.S. National Archives)

field_map.key: dedup key: approvals appl|submission|date; adcom = Federal Register document_number
field_map.date: event date YYYY-MM-DD (approval status date; adcom MEETING date parsed from the notice — null when unparsed)
field_map.sponsor: sponsor/applicant name (adcom: best-effort from the notice title)
field_map.title: FR notice title, truncated 300 (adcom — carries committee/sponsor/BLA/drug)
field_map.pub: FR publication date — when the public could KNOW about the meeting (the honest event-knowledge date for adcom)
field_map.dateConf: 'parsed' | 'unparsed' — meeting-date extraction confidence; unparsed rows keep date:null, never guessed
field_map.rt: as-seen date (UTC day WE fetched it)

confidence_model: approval rows are confirmed regulatory events, already public when archived. adcom rows are scheduled FUTURE events; the meeting date is parsed from official notice text with confidence labeled — the IV-ramp hypothesis (gate 2) runs on parsed adcom dates vs our own archived option chains. NO forward PDUFA dates (legally unavailable free; follow-on files 8-K-disclosed dates as labeled estimates).
cadence: 6h poll (2 requests/cycle); approvals over a rolling 30-day window with dedup; adcom newest-40 notices
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
